EXPTRACK 1.7.1

Install EXPTRACK-1.7.1.apk over your existing app; do not uninstall.

Expense popup has extra top space for notched phones. + Add Another remains beside Close. Each new expense stacks underneath the previous card; scroll the cards while header and Save all stay visible. Every entry has separate amount, date, category and note fields. Existing records, login, reminders and atomic batch saving are preserved.
